outcome: A text-changing effect rewrites only words used in their proper sense, so a card name containing a color or type word is left unchanged.
A text-changing effect applied to a token-creating spell or ability changes the created token's creature type and name.
An ability granted by an effect is not altered by a text-changing effect on the same object.
A text-changing effect on a token changes the token's subtypes and rules text.
Exchange of Words swaps the rules text of two objects so each has the other's abilities.
An object with the full text of another object takes its name, mana cost, color indicator, power, toughness, rules text and type line text.
An object with all names of nonlegendary creature cards has every one of those names.
An effect that sets an object's name replaces all its previous names with only the specified name.

note: Name stickers are Unfinity sticker-sheet components; Forge has no sticker sheets (grep finds only the cards Name Sticker Goblin and Nimble Birdsticker).

outcome: A spell with splice resolves with the spliced card's rules text added after its own text, and the spliced text's effects occur.
